    local originalStatements = entity.claims[propertyId]
    if not originalStatements then
        return {}
    end

    removeQualifiersAndReferences(entity, propertyId)

    local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(originalStatements)

    restoreQualifiersAndReferences(originalStatements, cloneOfStatements)
